<function name="SetPlayerColor" parent="Player" type="classfunc">
	<description>Sets the player model's color. The part of the model that is colored is determined by the model itself, and is different for each model.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="Color" type="Vector">This is the color to be set. The format is Vector(r, g, b), and each color should be between 0 and 1.</arg>
	</args>
</function>

<example>
	<description>When a player spawns their color will be red.</description>
	<code>
hook.Add( "PlayerSpawn", "PlayerColor", function( ply )
	ply:SetPlayerColor( Vector( 1, 0, 0 ) )
end)
	</code>
</example>


<example>
	<description>A function you could use to set the player's color to a <page>Global.Color</page> rather than a <page>Vector</page>.</description>
	<code>
function SetColor( ply, color )
	ply:SetPlayerColor( Vector( color.r / 255, color.g / 255, color.b / 255 ) )
end
	</code>
</example>
